mapper.select: select rrs.rule_id as rule_id, rrs.rule_version as rule_version, rrs.status as runtime_status, rv.status as version_status, rv.script_hash as script_hash, rv.script_json as script_json, rv.matcher_json as version_matcher_json, rt.id as target_id, rt.class_name as target_class_name, rt.method_name as target_method_name, rt.matcher_json as target_matcher_json, rt.location as target_location, rt.call_site_selector_json as target_call_site_selector_json from rule_runtime_status rrs join rule_version rv on rv.rule_id = rrs.rule_id and rv.version = rrs.rule_version left join rule_target rt on rt.id = ( select t.id from rule_target t where t.rule_version_id = rv.id order by t.created_at, t.id limit 1 ) where rrs.instance_id = #{instanceId}
select a.id as agent_id, a.instance_id as instance_id, i.process_start_id as process_start_id from agent_instance a join instance i on i.id = a.instance_id where a.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into degraded_class (id, agent_id, class_name, reason, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) values (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{className}, #{reason}, #{now}, #{now})
